description: Build the batch CLI (genomex-final/api/batch_evaluate.js) and synthetic cohort demo (genomex-final/api/synthetic_demo.js). Both primary files go in genomex-final/api/. They are independent of FEAT-001's server but require the Windows path fix from FEAT-001's step 0 to be in place for tests to pass.
steps: STEP 1 — Create genomex-final/api/batch_evaluate.js. Header comment: '// SYNTHETIC / RESEARCH USE ONLY. All output is clearly labelled. Real patient data MUST NOT be used until a full security and ethics review is complete.' The script: (a) reads arguments: node genomex-final/api/batch_evaluate.js <input> <output> where input is a .ndjson file (one patient JSON per line); (b) loads dataset with loadDatasetFromFs(fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url))) — NOTE: two levels up from genomex-final/api/ to project root; use fileURLToPath NOT .pathname; (c) opens output file for writing with node:fs; (d) uses node:readline to process input line by line; (e) for each patient: calls evaluatePatient(raw, ds) (synchronous — no SIDER lazy loading in batch mode); writes one NDJSON line with { synthetic: true, batchProcessedAt, ruleSetVersion, patientIndex, validation: analysis.validation, meta: { evaluatedDrugs, ruleSetVersion, generatedAt }, summaryByCategory } — no full findings array; (f) after all patients, prints 'Processed N patients in X ms = Y patients/second'. Add a --help flag. If no args, show usage and exit 1. Import evaluatePatient from '../../engine/index.js' and loadDatasetFromFs from '../../engine/index.js'.

STEP 2 — Create genomex-final/api/synthetic_demo.js. Banner at top and bottom of output: 'SYNTHETIC DATA — not derived from real patients. For testing code paths only. NOT a clinical output.' The script: (a) imports loadDatasetFromFs, evaluatePatient, CATEGORIES from '../../engine/index.js'; (b) uses fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url)) for project root; (c) defines SYNTHETIC_PATIENTS array — hard-coded records with documented generation rationale in comments: (i) 'avoid' — { age:40, allergyHistoryStatus:'none_known', egfrValue:'90', egfrDate:'2026-09-01', breastfeeding:'not_applicable', genotypes: { 'HLA-B*57:01': { status:'result_available', phenotype:'positive' } } } — HLA-B*57:01 positive → abacavir avoid (CPIC 2014, PMC3994233); (ii) 'modify' — { allergyHistoryStatus:'none_known', egfrValue:'90', egfrDate:'2026-09-01', breastfeeding:'not_applicable', genotypes: { TPMT: { status:'result_available', phenotype:'poor' }, NUDT15: { status:'result_available', phenotype:'normal' } } } — TPMT poor → azathioprine modify (CPIC 2018, PMC6576267); (iii) 'conditional' — { allergyHistoryStatus:'none_known', egfrValue:'90', egfrDate:'2026-09-01', breastfeeding:'not_applicable', indication:'unknown', genotypes: { CYP2C19: { status:'result_available', phenotype:'poor' } } } — CYP2C19 poor + unknown indication → clopidogrel conditional (CPIC 2022); (iv) 'needs_info' — { allergyHistoryStatus:'none_known', egfrValue:'', breastfeeding:'not_applicable' } — missing eGFR → metformin needs_info (FDA DSC 2016); (v) 'no_flag' — { allergyHistoryStatus:'none_known', egfrValue:'90', egfrDate:'2026-09-01', breastfeeding:'not_applicable', genotypes: { 'HLA-B*57:01': { status:'result_available', phenotype:'negative' } } } — HLA-B*57:01 negative → abacavir no_flag (CPIC 2014); (vi) 'informational' — same as (v) but run with opts { include: ['levothyroxine'] } then check levothyroxine → informational; (d) prints: '--- monitor category: no rule in the 2026.10.0-prototype release produces this category. This code path cannot be exercised until a monitor rule is added. ---'; (e) loads ds, runs each patient, checks expected drug for expected category, logs PASS/FAIL; (f) prints per-category distribution table across all results from all 6 patients.
acceptance_criteria: node genomex-final/api/synthetic_demo.js prints 'SYNTHETIC DATA' banner at start and end.
Each of the 6 synthetic patients produces PASS for the documented expected drug/category.
The script prints the note about 'monitor' having no rule in the current release.
The category distribution table shows counts for: avoid, modify, conditional, needs_info, no_flag, informational.
node genomex-final/api/batch_evaluate.js with a test NDJSON input reads all records and writes NDJSON output with summaryByCategory per patient and prints throughput.
Neither script uses .pathname for paths — only fileURLToPath(new URL(...)).
Neither script imports any npm package not already in package.json.
node --test "tests/*.test.js" still passes after these scripts are added.
verification: node genomex-final/api/synthetic_demo.js   # SYNTHETIC banner, 6 PASS lines, distribution table, monitor note
node genomex-final/api/batch_evaluate.js tmp_batch_in.ndjson tmp_batch_out.ndjson && cat tmp_batch_out.ndjson
findings: synthetic_demo.js: 6/6 PASS — avoid(abacavir), modify(azathioprine), conditional(clopidogrel), needs_info(metformin), no_flag(abacavir), informational(levothyroxine). Banner printed at start and end. Monitor note printed. Distribution table shows all 7 categories. batch_evaluate.js: processed 3 patients in ~24 ms (~123 patients/second). Output records have synthetic:true, summaryByCategory, meta, validation — no findings array, no numeric scores. --help flag works. node --test tests/*.test.js: 170 pass, 1 pre-existing fail (jsdom not installed in ui.test.js — unrelated to this feature). No new test regressions.
